description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef' used for attribute validation and cleaning within the HTMLPurifier library. It provides methods for validation, parsing CDATA, and processing CSS color and escape sequences, serving as a core component for attribute definition and validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef
classes.description: An abstract base class for defining and validating HTML attribute data, including mechanisms for cleaning and parsing attribute values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Abstract method to validate and clean a string based on attribute-specific rules.

methods.name: parseCDATA
methods.description: Parses a string as CDATA, trimming whitespace and replacing certain characters.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate or retrieve an attribute definition object from a string.

methods.name: mungeRgb
methods.description: Removes spaces from CSS rgb/rgba/hsl/hsla color definitions to support shorthand color notation.

methods.name: expandCSSEscape
methods.description: Decodes CSS escape sequences in a string to produce a 'pure' CSS string.
